recommended_metrics.open_draft_pulls: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pulls.state = 'open' AND pulls.is_draft = TRUE)
recommended_metrics.merged_pulls: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pulls.merged_at IS NOT NULL)
recommended_metrics.closed_unmerged_pulls: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pulls.state = 'closed' AND pulls.merged_at IS NULL)
recommended_metrics.mean_merge_hours: AVG(pulls.merge_hours) FILTER (WHERE pulls.merged_at IS NOT NULL)
recommended_metrics.median_merge_hours: MEDIAN(pulls.merge_hours) FILTER (WHERE pulls.merged_at IS NOT NULL)
recommended_metrics.p90_merge_hours: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pulls.merge_hours) FILTER (WHERE pulls.merged_at IS NOT NULL)

merge_hours.validation: For merged rows require finite non-NULL created_at/merged_at and merged_at >= created_at.

caveats: Merge duration is elapsed creation-to-merge hours, including drafts and waiting; not review time, business hours or deployment lead time.
Use merge time UTC half-open [start_day,end_day) date intervals for merge reports.
Bots remain included; requested_reviewers lists outstanding requests, not actual reviews.

result_columns.name: run_started_at
result_columns.description: When the current attempt started executing.

result_columns.name: updated_at
result_columns.description: When the run last changed; for a completed run, effectively when it finished.

caveats: One row per run with latest reported attempt/state; not all attempts.
Reliability denominator includes only success/failure/timed_out, excludes cancelled/skipped/neutral/stale/action_required/NULL.
updated_at is last modification and not an authoritative completion timestamp; do not publish exact run duration.
run_attempt>1 counts rerun runs, not total rerun events.

functions.name: all_rate_limit
functions.description: GitHub API rate-limit budgets (the scan backing the `rate_limit` table)

result_columns.name: resource
result_columns.description: Which budget this row describes: 'core' (most endpoints), 'search', 'graphql', ...

result_columns.name: request_limit
result_columns.description: Requests allowed per window: 60/hour anonymously, 5,000 with a token.

result_columns.name: used
result_columns.description: Requests spent in the current window.

result_columns.name: remaining
result_columns.description: Count of requests left before the window resets.

result_columns.name: reset_at
result_columns.description: When the window resets and remaining returns to request_limit.

common_contract.identity_scope: All identifiers are scoped to one GitHub instance. Repository names and account logins are mutable labels.
common_contract.consistency: live_explicit; no transactional GitHub snapshot or historical AT guarantee.
common_contract.reporting_limits: Keyed list reports require max_rows=0 and fail when page or row bounds prevent complete traversal.
common_contract.cache: cache_ttl omitted/NULL inherits attachment; zero follows GitHub policy, not cache bypass.
common_contract.nested_columns: VARCHAR[] detail values preserve the source row grain. No implicit UNNEST.
common_contract.aggregate_nulls: COUNT(*) returns zero for an empty ungrouped population. SUM/AVG/percentiles return NULL when no input values qualify.
common_contract.duration_validation: Merged/closed duration populations must have finite non-NULL ordered endpoints; reject invalid source rows rather than silently alter denominators.

relationship_guidance: Carry original requested repository argument as the conformed invocation scope: source listings often stamp requested names while repo lookups return redirected canonical names.
Only declare raw to-one joins with proven unique target keys. repo/number is scoped to repository; account logins and repository names are mutable.
Aggregate issues/pulls/commits/workflow runs independently before approved joining by repository/date; raw fact joins multiply measures.
head_sha does not uniquely select a workflow run or PR.
Merge day, queue day, publication day and author day describe different events; any common calendar comparison must label those meanings.
missing_source_facts: PR reviews/review comments for first-review and approval latency
Issue timeline/state-change/reopen events for historical backlog and reopen rates
Workflow job/completion and per-attempt history for exact run/queue duration and attempt reliability
Deployments/environments/statuses for production delivery frequency and DORA metrics
PR/commit diff statistics for additions/deletions/changed files
Event or observation history for star losses/net growth and past repository snapshots
Explicit membership child facts for label/topic/assignee/reviewer grouped metrics
window_guidance: Calendar previous-period/moving-average recipes currently require a direct stored DATE with enforced NOT NULL. Invocation-derived timestamps cast to DATE do not satisfy that contract. General model-authored windows can use declared approved grouped grain but their invocation composition needs execution qualification; do not label previous observed row as previous calendar day or mean-of-daily-means as weighted per-PR duration.
